note: Package names and the variables these servers read are theirs, not ours. A name that has moved shows as mcp.failed with npx's own words, which is why this file carries a date the way the model catalogue does.

servers.label: Brave Search
servers.note: Web search. This is what Agbrte has instead of a search tool: the vendor, the endpoint and the key are yours, and the fetch tool reads a page once you have its address.

servers.label: GitHub
servers.note: Issues, pull requests and code search on repositories the token can see. A personal access token, scoped to what you actually want reachable from a session.
